_doc: VRAM each render mode asks Herakles for, in MiB, BEFORE the margin.
Read on every render (morpheus.need_for) — editing this needs no restart.
need = figure + margin_mib. 'provisional' means NOT YET MEASURED: replace
it with a measurement taken through the lease and drop the flag.
Wan presets carry two figures. policy 'resident' = enough room that the 14B
model can stay on the card (Whisper is evicted for the render — the ruled
default, 2026-10-07). policy 'streamed' = the measured A option: weights
streamed from RAM, Whisper stays loaded, 70 MiB spare beside it (2026-10-07).

qwen.note: QWEN_NEED_MB; Qwen peak measured 14,467 MiB on 2026-09-22

wan-fast.streamed_note: measured 2026-10-07: ComfyUI peak 10,354 MiB with 10,724 free, 12m45s, model fully offloaded
